source_dir.description: The source directory containing the FLAC/Ogg Vorbis files to be transcoded.

mount_point.description: The mount point where the virtual MP3 filesystem will appear.

bitrate.description: The bitrate for MP3 encoding in kbps (e.g., 128, 192, 320).

quality.description: LAME encoding quality (0-9). 0 is best quality/slowest, 9 is worst/fastest.

gain_ref_db.description: Reference loudness for ReplayGain adjustments in decibels.

stat_cache_size.description: Number of cached stat entries to store for performance.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Leave empty to disable file logging.

log_syslog.description: Output logging messages to the system log.

log_max_level.description: Maximum log level: ERROR, INFO, or DEBUG.

foreground.description: Run in the foreground instead of detaching.
